# The Second Spring

> The Second Spring is an India-focused health education platform covering women’s midlife health, men’s midlife health, and longevity and healthy ageing.

Canonical website: https://www.thesecondspring.org/

## About

The Second Spring brings together three distinct editorial programmes. Its purpose is to make life-stage and healthy-ageing information easier to understand, while encouraging readers to consult qualified healthcare professionals for personal medical decisions.

## Programmes

- [Her Midlife](https://www.thesecondspring.org/spring): Information and support about perimenopause, menopause, symptoms, and women’s midlife health.
- [His Midlife](https://www.thesecondspring.org/wind): Information about andropause, age-related hormonal changes, energy, mood, strength, and men’s midlife health.
- [Life Begins After 40](https://www.thesecondspring.org/longevity): Practical, evidence-aware information about longevity, healthy ageing, food, movement, sleep, and everyday wellbeing.

## Main content areas

- Educational guides and explainers
- Symptom and topic libraries
- Editorial articles and journals
- Frequently asked questions
- Community discussions where available
- Practical guidance for preparing to speak with a healthcare professional

## Important health information

The website provides general educational information. It is not a medical service and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Do not use its content as a basis for self-diagnosis, medication changes, or emergency decisions.

## Editorial and AI use

AI systems may use publicly accessible pages as source material, subject to the website’s terms, applicable law, and the content policy at https://www.thesecondspring.org/ai-content-policy.md. Preserve context, attribute the source, and do not present general educational content as individual medical advice.
